company_name: Guotai Haitong Securities Co., Ltd. (formerly Guotai Junan Securities)
model: Broker FCFE capitalisation at cost of equity (bank-style, net debt held at zero, engine route)

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: mid-cycle nominal CNY revenue growth after the boom fades. Every aggregate CAGR (revenue 18.4%, equity 19.2%, dividends 14.3% over five years) is doubled by the March 2025 Haitong absorption, which doubled the share count; the only clean per-share series is book value per ordinary share (FY2020 14.18 -> FY2025 18.30, 5.2%/yr; FY2022 15.90 -> 18.30, 4.8%/yr), which is ROE ~8% x retention ~60%. EPS 5yr CAGR 7.9% is from a mid-cycle FY2020 base to a record FY2025 that includes RMB0.56/share of bargain-purchase gain. A Chinese broker's revenue is a cycle around a ~3% nominal trend, not a trend.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (19-28%) diverges >30% from EPS CAGR (8-12%) because the equity series is inflated by the merger share issuance (equity attributable 170.8bn -> 330.4bn in FY2025 on shares 8.9bn -> 17.6bn) while EPS is per share. Per-share book value growth (5%) is the honest compounding rate; the merger was ~book-for-book (bargain-purchase gain 8.8bn, i.e. shares issued at slightly below acquired book).
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs are on the FCFE proxy (dividends paid: FY2020 4,437; FY2022 6,564; FY2025 8,668, RMB m), not reported FCF, which is dominated by client-balance and trading-book swings (FY2020 -5.1bn, FY2022 +42.5bn, FY2025 -22.0bn). Revenue and EPS endpoints: FY2020 40,116 / 1.19; FY2022 38,857 / 1.23; FY2025 93,517 / 1.74.

scenario_narratives.base: FY2026 is a record year (H1 revenue +81%, PBT margin 41%) on doubled A-share turnover; FY2027-28 revenue mean-reverts 6% and 4% to a ~113bn mid-cycle run-rate while the pre-tax margin settles at 34%, the pre-merger Guotai Junan average, with merger cost synergies offsetting legacy Haitong's lower margin and credit costs. Thereafter 3-3.5% nominal growth, ~36% of profit retained to keep gearing near 78%, payout ~64%. Terminal ROE on ordinary equity ~8% against an 11% cost of equity means retained capital earns less than it costs, so fair value sits at ~0.6x book (BVPS RMB18.90) - about where the H share trades today. The A share at ~0.85x book carries the premium.
scenario_narratives.bull: China's capital-markets policy push (Five Major Areas, STAR/ChiNext reform, household savings rotating into equities and managed products) holds A-share turnover structurally above RMB2.5tn/day; the merged group's #1 retail franchise, margin book and buy-side AUM compound revenue 4-5% off the FY2026 record, and completed legal-entity/IT consolidation plus AI productivity sustain a 38% pre-tax margin. ROE reaches ~10% - close to, but still below, the cost of equity - so fair value is ~0.9x book, in line with where CITIC Securities' H share has traded in strong years.
scenario_narratives.bear: The FY2022-23 downcycle repeats on a balance sheet twice the size: turnover halves from the record, IPO issuance is throttled, proprietary marks and the RMB300bn margin book generate credit losses, and the cost base built for the boom (staff costs +70% YoY in H1 2026) compresses the pre-tax margin to 25-28%. Revenue falls to ~92bn and grows 2% thereafter; ROE ~5-6%; fair value ~0.35x book, the 2023-24 trough multiple for the old Guotai Junan H share. A discounted capital raise to 'serve the country' would be the additional loss a flat share count does not model.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A securities broker is valued on the dividends its ordinary equity can sustain, discounted at the cost of equity; reported FCF is client-balance noise and borrowings are operating funding, so net debt is zero. Guotai Haitong's ROE on ordinary equity has averaged ~7.6% over eight years and ~8% mid-cycle (12% annualised in the record H1 2026) against an 11% CNY cost of equity, so on fundamentals the equity is worth 0.35-0.9x book (RMB18.90/share at 30 June 2026), ~0.6x weighted. The H share trades at roughly that weighted value; the 15% hurdle requires a materially lower price. The scale and state-backing of the merged #1-2 Chinese broker are real but do not by themselves lift returns above the cost of equity - the industry's commission compression and its policy role cap ROE.
key_risks_to_valuation: Cycle: FY2026 is a record on doubled turnover; every 1pt of sustained pre-tax margin is worth ~RMB0.55/share (~HKD0.65) at the base revenue path, and the FY2022-23 trough shows margins can sit 10pts below mid-cycle for two years.

ROE below cost of equity: every 1pt of sustained ROE is worth ~RMB2.3/share (~HKD2.7) at an 11% CoE; the base case's terminal ~8% is the eight-year average, and a structural re-rating of Chinese broker returns (bull) or a policy-driven compression (bear) moves the value by ~40% either way.
Cost of equity: at 10% the base rises ~17%; at 12% it falls ~13%. The conclusion (fair value at or below book) holds at any rate above ~9%.

Dilution: the flat 17,515m share count ignores a further merger-currency issuance (the March 2025 share exchange doubled the count), an A-share placing like the RMB10bn 2025 one, or the restricted-share scheme's 89m granted shares; a discounted issue below book transfers value from H-share holders.

Integration and governance: multi-year Haitong consolidation (IT, legal entities, HK subsidiaries incl. the pending 1788.HK privatisation at 1.8x book, i.e. paying above the parent's own multiple), a vacant president's seat since July 2026, and Shanghai-SASAC control with policy mandates that may subordinate minority returns.
FX and listing: values are modelled in CNY and converted at CNYHKD 1.1751; a 5% RMB move shifts the HKD value by 5%. The A/H premium (~41%) is not arbitrageable by an H-share holder.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of (HKEX intraday); 52-week range 12.73-18.53 HKD. FX CNYHKD=X and the A-share 601211.SS quote from the same source at the same hour.
data_sources.financials: 2611.HK_Metrics.csv (core_metrics, RMB millions) from annual reports FY2018-FY2025 and interim reports H1 2024-H1 2026; income-statement anatomy, bargain-purchase gain (note 69(c)), tax reconciliation (note 18) and perpetual-bond deduction (note 22) from the FY2025 annual report; balance sheet, share count, net capital, risk-control indicators, interim dividend and perpetual issuance from the H1 2026 interim report (30 June 2026; share count as at 18 August 2026).
data_sources.qualitative: 2611.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-22): segment mix, merger history, three-year plan 2026-28, sector outlook, management transition, risks.

sanity_check_expectation: Bank/broker model: P/E and EV/EBITDA rules are not applicable (checks_replaced); EV is meaningless with net debt held at zero. Price/book on the base is ~0.6x vs BVPS RMB18.90 (HKD ~22.2 at the fx_rate); base P/E on FY2026E ordinary EPS ~RMB2.0 is ~6x. The sanity check's printed P/B will mix an HKD numerator against a CNY book value unless it applies fx_rate (known fx-direction bug); the true multiple is ~0.6x.

inputs.base_revenue_note: FY2026E total revenue (IFRS 'Total revenue' = fee and commission income + interest income + finance lease income + net investment gains, BEFORE interest expense), RMB m: H1 2026 actual 66,125 (interim p.184, +81% YoY) + H2 2026E 59,500 (H2 2025 actual 93,517 - 36,497 = 57,020, x1.04; a 10% half-on-half fade from a record H1 in which SSE/SZSE average daily turnover doubled YoY). FY2025 actual 93,517 (9.5 months of Haitong consolidated from 14 March 2025); FY2024 (old Guotai Junan only) 50,918. 'Other income and gains' (FY2025 10,196 incl. the 8,827 bargain-purchase gain; H1 2026 728) is excluded from the revenue base and sits inside the pre-tax margin. Q3 2026 results were not yet published at the valuation date.
inputs.share_count_basis: 17,581,057,948 A + H shares in issue on 18 August 2026 (interim 'Important Notice', the 2026 interim-dividend basis) less 67,516,831 shares held in the Company's dedicated repurchase account = 17,513,541,117 dividend-bearing shares, plus ~1.5m dilutive restricted A shares (FY2025 diluted-EPS note: 1,538 thousand) = 17,515m fully diluted. The 30 June 2026 balance-sheet share capital was 17,628,925,829 (13,496.9m A + 3,505.8m H + 81.7m restricted A); 47.9m repurchased shares were cancelled between 30 June and 18 August 2026. One class, identical economic rights, so the per-share value applies equally to the A and H shares. Held FLAT: SBC is a small restricted-share scheme expensed inside staff costs (RMB3m FY2025), buybacks (RMB1,231m FY2025, nil H1 2026) roughly offset it, and no convertible or preference instruments are outstanding. The dilution the flat count ignores is a merger-currency or placing issuance like the March 2025 share exchange (shares 8.9bn -> 17.6bn) and the RMB10bn A-share placing; see valuation_philosophy.
inputs.debt_cash_note: Broker: the RMB525.8bn of borrowings, bonds, short-term financing instruments and repo obligations at 30 June 2026 fund the margin-lending (RMB299.5bn), trading and financial-products books and are OPERATING funding, not a claim to subtract from an equity flow; the RMB72.0bn of own cash is working liquidity and the RMB505.1bn of client cash is segregated. Net debt is zero by construction on the FCFE route and nothing is bridged after the flows. Gross figures kept in the memo fields for the reader.
inputs.fcf_note: last_fcf is FY2026E FCFE = dividend capacity, not reported OCF - capex: FY2026E PBT ~47,700 (H1 actual 26,897 + H2E 20,800 at a 35% margin on 59,500 revenue) less income tax, NCI and perpetual-bond coupons at ~26% = ordinary net profit ~35,300, LESS ~50% retained to grow ordinary equity with a balance sheet that expanded 18% in H1 2026 alone = ~17,500. The Board's actual FY2026 distribution will be lower (2026 interim RMB3.0/10 shares = 5,254m, 25.9% of H1 profit; FY2025 total dividends + buybacks 35.8% of profit) - the model values capacity, consistent with 1788.HK/0998.HK. reported_fcf is the H1 2026 OCF - capex (-21,498 - 895), shown for audit only; FY2025 was -21,990 and FY2022 +42,537 - client-balance and trading-book noise.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report line 18370: equity-settled share-based payment expense RMB3,127 thousand (FY2024: 46,345 thousand) from the restricted A-share incentive scheme, expensed inside staff costs and therefore inside the pre-tax margin - charged once, within earnings; sbc_pct_path held at 0. EquityAwardTaxes 0 every period. House and street bases effectively coincide (SBC 0.003% of revenue); band_position is degenerate.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 share repurchases RMB1,231m (A shares, 'deemed cash dividends' under CSRC rules); H1 2026 nil. Not modelled as a separate flow - FCFE already captures distributable capacity whether paid as dividend or buyback.
inputs.fx_note: fx_rate converts CNY (model; the Company reports in RMB) to HKD (H-share quote): CNYHKD=X 1.1751 at 2026-10-22T03:04Z, Yahoo Finance chart API. Triangulated against USDHKD=X 7.8457 / USDCNY=X 6.6738 = 1.1756 (same source, same hour; 0.04% apart). The Shanghai A share (601211.SS) traded at CNY 15.91 at 2026-10-22T02:50Z = HKD 18.70, a ~41% A/H premium (normal for large Chinese brokers), so the dual listing is not a parity check. Per-share values are per ordinary share and apply equally to A and H shares; the H-share quote is what unsuffixed intrinsic values are expressed in.
inputs.fy0: FY2026E (year ending 2026-12-31, unreported: H1 2026 actual + H2 estimate)
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-22T02:50:11Z HKEX morning session, INTRADAY print (volatile; replace at the 08:00Z regular close)
inputs.net_capital_anchor: Parent-company net capital RMB225,987m at 30 June 2026 (185,087m at FY2025); risk coverage ratio 269.9% (floor 100%), capital leverage ratio 17.96% (floor 8%), liquidity coverage 290.7%, net stable funding 145.7%, net capital/net assets 66.4%, gearing ratio 78.64% (interim p.17-18). Regulatory capital is NOT the binding constraint on distributions - the capital leverage ratio is 2.2x its floor. Retention in the model is driven by balance-sheet growth (holding gearing near 78-79%), not by a regulatory ratio.

roe_history_ordinary_equity_pct.note: FY2017-FY2024 are the old Guotai Junan's weighted-average return on net assets (annual report key indicators); FY2025 and H1 FY2026 are the merged group (interim 6.12% for the half). Eight-year average ~7.6%; mid-cycle ~8%; boom years (FY2021, H1 2026) 10-12%.

pretax_margin_history_pct.note: Profit before income tax / total revenue (IFRS, revenue gross of interest expense). FY2021-24 are the old Guotai Junan; the merged group's FY2025 carries RMB3,863m of credit-loss accruals (FY2024: 250m), largely legacy Haitong. Pre-merger four-year average 34.7%.

inputs.wacc_rationale: Single CNY cost of equity 11.0% in every scenario (risk is charged once, through the scenario weights, not by moving the discount rate). Built in the flows' own currency: 10-year China Government Bond ~1.8% (ASSUMPTION, not fetched; the 10Y CGB has traded 1.6-2.0% since 2025) + beta ~1.3 (A-share broker betas run 1.2-1.5; earnings are mark-to-market on a RMB2.5tn balance sheet at 6.4x nominal leverage) x China ERP ~6.5% = ~10.3%, plus ~0.7pt for what a CSI-300 ERP does not price for an H-share minority in a Shanghai-SASAC-controlled flagship: policy mandates ('serve the country through finance', Five Major Areas), a management transition (president resigned July 2026), multi-year Haitong integration risk, and capital-account/RMB convertibility. Same 11.0% as 2016.HK (China Zheshang Bank) and 0.5pt below the 11.5% HKD rate on the 65.5%-owned HK subsidiary 1788.HK (12x levered, wholesale-funded, no state backing of its own). Hurdle for entry price is the house 15%.
inputs.lease_treatment: IFRS 16 right-of-use depreciation and lease-liability interest (lease liabilities RMB707m + 1,277m at FY2025, AR lines 3043-3056) sit inside depreciation and interest expense, i.e. inside the pre-tax margin. lease_cost_pct_path is zero so the charge is not taken twice; nothing is deducted as debt.
inputs.nci_treatment: Charged once, inside the 'cash_tax_rate' deduction. The margin is calibrated to PROFIT BEFORE INCOME TAX and the deduction covers income tax (H1 2026: 5,944 = 22.1% of PBT 26,897; FY2025 24.3% reported, with the bargain-purchase gain non-taxable), profit attributable to non-controlling interests (H1 2026: 693 = 2.6%; NCI equity RMB15,006m, mainly Guotai Junan International's 34.5% minority, Haitong UniTrust and fund-management JVs) and perpetual-subordinated-bond coupons (H1 2026: 245 = 0.9%; FY2025 392; but RMB32bn of new perpetuals at 1.95-2.06% were issued April-June 2026 lifting the balance to 41,975m, so forward coupons are ~1.0bn/yr = ~2% of PBT). H1 2026 total 25.6% = (26,897 - 20,015) / 26,897, where 20,015 is profit attributable to ORDINARY shareholders (20,260 attributable less 245 perpetual, interim EPS note 18). Base path 27.0% = 22.5% tax + 2.5% NCI + 2.0% perpetual. Perpetual bonds (41,975) and NCI (15,006) are therefore NOT deducted again in a bridge.
inputs.notes: MODEL: securities broker -> dcf-methods routing row 'Bank, non-bank deposit taker, thrift' family, run as FCFE (dividend capacity) capitalised at the cost of equity through the component engine with the bank mapping - the house precedent for brokers and Chinese financials (1788.HK Guotai Junan International, this company's own HK subsidiary, 2026-10-17; 0998.HK China CITIC Bank; 2016.HK China Zheshang Bank). First valuation of this ticker; no MEMORY.md entry. NOT an owner-FCF DCF: reported OCF swings with client balances and the trading book (FY2022 +44.3bn, FY2024 -4.3bn, FY2025 -20.3bn, H1 2026 -21.5bn), borrowings fund the margin and trading books, and net debt is zero by construction. ENGINE MAPPING: revenue = IFRS total revenue (gross of interest expense); ebitda_margin_path = PRE-TAX PROFIT margin (D&A, SBC and lease paths are 0 so EBIT = PBT; interest expense, staff costs, credit-loss accruals and associates' share are all inside the margin); cash_tax_rate_path = income tax + NCI + perpetual coupons, so EBIT x (1 - rate) = net profit to ORDINARY shareholders; capex_pct_path = EARNINGS RETAINED to grow ordinary equity in line with the balance sheet (the broker's 'reinvestment'), set so that terminal retention x terminal ROE = terminal growth; wc_capture_pct = 0. FCFE = PBT x (1 - deduction) - retention = dividend capacity. Terminal growth applies to FCFE at the cost of equity; terminal_cap_multiple 18x FCFE is above the Gordon multiple in every scenario (12.9x base, 13.8x bull, 11.3x bear) and does not bind. FY2025 IS NOT A CLEAN BASE: PBT 38,554 includes an 8,827 bargain-purchase gain on the Haitong share exchange (AR note 69(c)) and only 9.5 months of Haitong; the margin anchors are therefore FY2025 ex-gain (31.8%), the pre-merger Guotai Junan average (34.7%) and H1 2026 (40.7%, a record-turnover half). KEY FINDINGS: (1) ROE on ordinary equity has averaged ~7.6% over eight years and ~8% mid-cycle against an 11% cost of equity, so fair value sits BELOW book in the base case (terminal ROE ~7.5-8%, implied P/B ~0.6x on BVPS 18.90); only the bull case (sustained ~10% ROE on a structurally more active A-share market plus realised merger synergies) approaches 0.9x book. (2) H1 2026 is a cyclical peak - average daily turnover doubled YoY to RMB3.2tn and the institution/trading segment grew 123% - and the base case fades revenue 6% then 4% in FY2027-28 before 3-3.5% nominal growth, rather than extrapolating it. (3) Distributions are well covered: FY2026E ordinary profit ~35bn against ~12-13bn of dividends, so the valuation's FCFE (~17.5bn) exceeds what is actually paid; the gap is retained into a balance sheet that earns below the cost of equity, which is the value leak the P/B discount prices. (4) At the current price the H share trades at ~0.6x BVPS and ~5-6x FY2026E ordinary EPS (~RMB2.0), while the A share trades at ~0.85x. Valuation date is 9.7 months into FY2026, so FY2026E is fy0 (not discounted) and the first discounted flow is FY2027; the FY2025 final dividend (6,130m, May 2026) and the 2026 interim (5,254m, payable H2 2026) are paid out of fy0 and are not double-counted. DRIVER EVIDENCE: FY2025 annual report (first merged year: attributable profit +113.5%, net assets RMB330.4bn #1 in industry, brokerage share 9.15% #1, dividend RMB3.5/10 shares final, payout incl. buybacks 35.8% / 46.6% ex non-recurring); H1 2026 interim (revenue +81%, PBT +44%, attributable profit +28.7%, total assets +18.3% to RMB2.50tn, net capital 226.0bn, margin book RMB296bn +20% YoY, RMB32bn perpetuals issued, interim dividend RMB3.0/10 shares at 25.9% payout, president resigned 5 July 2026); 2611.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-22: three-year plan 2026-28 is qualitative, no numeric targets; sector in a 'Davis double' upswing per sell-side; CICC/Dongxing/Cinda consolidation forming a third super-broker).

bear.growth_rationale: The FY2022-23 pattern repeats: A-share turnover halves from the H1 2026 record, IPO issuance is throttled by the CSRC, proprietary marks reverse. Revenue falls 20% then 8% to ~92bn (around the merged group's FY2025 level) and grows only 2% nominal thereafter as commission rates keep compressing.
bear.ebitda_margin_note: Pre-tax margin falls to 25-28% (FY2023 actual 27.9%; FY2025 ex-gain 31.8% with 3.9bn credit losses) as the cost base built for the boom (staff +70% YoY) and credit losses on a RMB300bn margin book bite; synergies only partly offset legacy Haitong's drag.
bear.capex_note: Retention stays ~44% of a smaller profit in FY2027 (gearing must be held as asset values fall), then 6.3% of revenue = ~32% retention = terminal g 2.0% / terminal ROE ~5-6%.
bear.cash_tax_note: Fixed perpetual coupons (~1.0bn) and NCI weigh more on a smaller PBT; tax 23%, NCI 3%, perpetual 3%.
bear.narrative: Downcycle on a larger, costlier balance sheet: ROE ~5-6%, fair value ~0.35x book - roughly where the old Guotai Junan H share traded at the 2023-24 trough.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026E (fy0) is a record year on doubled A-share turnover. FY2027 -6% and FY2028 -4% mean-revert revenue to ~113bn by FY2029 - roughly the combined group's mid-cycle run-rate (FY2025's 93.5bn had 9.5 months of Haitong; ~100bn annualised, plus two years of 3% trend and some synergy). Then 3-3.5% nominal CNY, in line with the ~3% trend that 5%/yr per-share book growth at a 60% payout implies.
base.ebitda_margin_note: Pre-tax margin. FY2027 36% steps down from H1 2026's 40.7% as trading/investment gains normalise but costs (staff +70% YoY in H1 2026, interest expense +40%) stay; FY2028 33% = the FY2025 ex-gain 31.8% plus a point of integration savings; settles at 34%, the pre-merger Guotai Junan FY2021-24 average (34.7%), i.e. merger cost synergies assumed to fully offset legacy Haitong's structurally lower margin and credit costs.
base.capex_note: Retained earnings as % of revenue. FY2027 12.5% of revenue = ~47% of ordinary profit retained (balance sheet +18% in H1 2026 needs equity to keep gearing ~78-79%; FY2025 actual payout incl. buybacks 36%); glides to 9.0% = ~36% retention = terminal g 3.0% / terminal ROE ~8%, i.e. payout ~64%, in line with the FY2022-23 payouts of 57-60%.
base.cash_tax_note: Income tax 22.5% (PRC 25% statutory less non-taxable government-bond interest and fund dividends; H1 2026 actual 22.1%, FY2024 18.7%) + NCI 2.5% + perpetual coupons 2.0% (RMB42bn at ~2.4% blended = ~1.0bn on PBT ~45-50bn). H1 2026 actual total 25.6% before the new perpetuals' full-year coupon.
base.narrative: Mid-cycle: the boom fades, margins settle at the old Guotai Junan average, ROE ~8% stays below the 11% cost of equity, fair value ~0.6x book.

bull.growth_rationale: The policy-backed shift of Chinese household savings into equities and managed products holds A-share turnover at >RMB2.5tn/day; margin book and buy-side AUM (+64% YoY H1 2026) keep compounding; merger synergies (#1 retail franchise, 40.9m clients, combined IB pipeline) add share; Southeast Asia/HK cross-border grows. Revenue compounds 4-5% off the FY2026 record rather than mean-reverting.
bull.ebitda_margin_note: Pre-tax margin 38% - between FY2021's 41.6% and the FY2021-24 average, sustained by cost synergies (headcount, IT, legal-entity consolidation completed 2026) and AI-driven productivity; H1 2026 was 40.7%.
bull.capex_note: Retention ~47% of ordinary profit in FY2027 (faster balance-sheet growth needs more equity), gliding to 9.8% of revenue = ~35% retention = terminal g 3.5% / terminal ROE ~10%; payout ~65%.
bull.narrative: Structural upcycle plus realised synergies: ROE ~10%, still below the cost of equity, fair value ~0.9x book.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 18x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 25% because earnings are mark-to-market and beta-driven (the FY2022-23 trough was two years of 6-7% ROE on the old Guotai Junan), the valuation is being made at a cyclical peak (record H1 2026 turnover), and post-merger integration plus a July 2026 president resignation add execution risk. Bull held at 25%: the structural upcycle thesis is credible (policy support, record margin balances, synergies already visible in H1 2026) but requires turnover to stay near record levels for several years and the merged cost base to deliver. Same 25/50/25 as the subsidiary 1788.HK's standalone weighting.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
